facts.text: Located on Vancouver's harbour, steps from the Vancouver Convention Centre, the cruise terminal and the seawall.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont Waterfront boasts an unrivaled location. Steps from the Vancouver Convention Centre, cruise terminal, and the iconic seawall

facts.text: The hotel has a heated rooftop pool with panoramic views.
facts.excerpt: Relax by the heated rooftop pool with panoramic views

facts.text: A 2,100-square-foot rooftop garden, launched in 1996, grows herbs, fruits, vegetables and edible blossoms without herbicides or pesticides.
facts.excerpt: Launched in 1996, the 2,100-square-foot rooftop garden grows herbs, fruits, vegetables, and edible blossoms without the use of herbicides or pesticides.

facts.text: The hotel runs an outdoor Bee Program, with daily Bee Tours of the apiaries in the warmer months.
facts.excerpt: During the warmer months, the team offers daily Bee Tours that introduce guests to the world of beekeeping

facts.text: ARC Restaurant and Bar serves West Coast cuisine made with locally sourced ingredients and produce from the rooftop garden.
facts.excerpt: ARC Restaurant and Bar is the property’s singular on-site dining experience, featuring locally sourced ingredients and produce plucked straight from the rooftop garden

facts.text: Executive Chef Harris Sakalis created the Province to Plate menu at ARC, which changes seasonally.
facts.excerpt: Executive Harris Sakalis has created our Province to Plate menu at ARC highlighting the best of British Columbia’s seasonal bounty, changing seasonally

facts.text: Guests can use a complimentary bike program to ride the seawall.
facts.excerpt: you can travel by wheels thanks to the property’s complimentary bike program available to all guests

facts.text: The fitness centre is open 24 hours a day.
facts.excerpt: Our fully equipped fitness centre is accessible 24 hours a day.

facts.text: Fairmont Gold offers a hotel-within-a-hotel experience with private check-in and exclusive lounge access.
facts.excerpt: Experience Fairmont Gold with private check-in and exclusive lounge access.
Fairmont Waterfront warmly welcomes pets with amenities like comfy beds, bowls, and treats.

facts.text: The hotel offers a booking package with Talaysay Tours that includes a 90-minute walking tour led by a local First Nations guide.
facts.excerpt: special booking package which includes a 90-minute walking tour led by a local First Nations guide

facts.text: All guest rooms and signature suites are undergoing a renovation led by design studio CAMDI, scheduled to wrap in 2029.
facts.excerpt: Currently undergoing a massive renovation project across all 489 guest rooms and signature suites

facts.text: Self parking is available at the hotel for $58 per night.
